items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: This was the first time we saw Evrol Gardner.

ctx.x: Jimmy Blanton and Floyd, Floyd Smith, yes. And I didn't see Blanton any more for quite a while, as I probably told you before until I joined Fletcher, and we were in Pittsburgh, and he was in Pittsburgh. He was working on this boat with Fate Marble. I forget his name, it was a St. Louis band, and they -- this boat would sail between Pittsburgh and St. Louis, and he was there. I met him on the hill, in Pittsburgh that night, we were hanging out. This was the first time we saw Evrol Gardner. And he was -- still in…
